resources.string: ✅ Accessibility service is ON. Copy any phone number to get a prompt.
❌ Accessibility service is OFF. Tap the button below and enable "Copy2WA".
How it works: copy any phone number in any format (0817 996 027, +62-817-996-027, 62817996027, …) → a pop-up appears → tap "Open in WhatsApp" to start an empty chat with that number.
Default country code (numbers starting with 0 keep using this)
That doesn\'t look like a phone number
Shows a WhatsApp prompt when you copy a phone number
Copy2WA checks the clipboard only when its content changes. If the copied text is a phone number, it shows a prompt to open that number in WhatsApp. It never stores or uploads your clipboard.
